label: r04-E-T3-8
critiques: trialPrompt forbids opening, listing, searching, or printing anything under spe/evals/graders/ (which holds grade.py and judge.md), spe/evals/tasks/ (which holds answers.json), spe/predictions/, and spe/plans/. None of those paths is passed to the trial agents. A leak scan with LEAK_PATTERN voids any trial that touched them.
DRY is set from args.only, and that filters cells down to the listed ids. The gates paragraph says the dry run uses args.only ["B:T001","C2:T002"] with 2 trials, and it runs before the full launch.

Gate two is a grade.py selftest. It feeds the answers.json oracle back in, and it requires an empty label and a shifted wrong label to fail. Gate three regrades round 3's saved results with this round's grade.py as a control.

SPEND_CAP defaults to 40. reserveTrials and reserveAgent both check spent plus reserved against the cap before any agent call. They skip the work that does not fit and log it through capSkip ("SKIP ...: spend cap $40"), and the skips are kept in ledger.skipped.

Grade agents run grade.py and are told "Do not grade by hand". Pass or fail comes from category_ok and priority_ok. The Opus judge is told "Score tone only. Do not score whether the category or priority is right."
The Top-up phase picks cells with split: p > 0 && p < rs.length. Each of those cells gets TOPUP_PER_CELL=5 extra trials. The number of cells is capped at TOPUP_CELL_CAP=20 and logged.
The Synthesis phase runs a failure-analysis agent and a completeness critic. The round is held in one constant, ROUND = Number(args.round ?? 4), and RR is derived from it for the paths.
